title: TUI overview line shows progress and check drift
lead: The status line shows the project's done percentage and whether the generated render is stale, so the owner sees from the TUI when `r` is needed.
findings_note: owner request, session 2026-10-14: bring the TUI up to date with recent CLI features
boundary: **Not in this slice:** sync drift, reference checks, and running the full `check`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `View.status` (`src/slicer/tui.py:693`) shows only counts, sort and filters. After a note edit, the TUI asks "press r to render", but nothing shows that the render is still stale. The `r` key already computes the drift with `render.plan` and `render.compare` (`src/slicer/tui.py:404`). `slicer stats` computes completion in `_census` (`src/slicer/cli.py:3008`).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py`: lift the completion part of `_census` into a function the TUI can call. `stats` output is unchanged.
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `View.status` appends `N% done` and `render stale` when `render.compare` reports a difference. That is computed in `refresh` after each mutating action and on open, not on every keystroke.
- `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `tests/test_tui.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Status_ShowsDonePercent`
- `test_Status_AfterNoteEdit_ShowsRenderStale`, then `test_Status_AfterRenderKey_ClearsStale`
- `test_Refresh_NavigationKey_DoesNotRecomputeDrift`, using a counting stub on `render.compare`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Lift the census helper and add the drift cache.
3. Update the docs and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The affected tests, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s279`, branch `feature/s279-tui-overview`. Commit only on the branch.
